documents.title: Artifact Output
documents.text: Artifact workers write files under GOBLIN_ARTIFACT_ROOT and list them in the result envelope.

documents.title: Local RAG Fixture
documents.text: The RAG first-use-case recipe performs retrieval augmented generation over local fixture documents. It returns a deterministic result envelope without model calls, cloud services, or credentials.

documents.title: Service Worker
documents.text: Service workers expose local HTTP endpoints with health probes and stable JSON payloads for admin inspection.

documents.title: Task Worker
documents.text: Task workers read GOBLIN_INPUT_PATH and GOBLIN_CONTEXT_PATH, then write a success or failed envelope to GOBLIN_RESULT_PATH.
